about_the_game:
Nikita is no longer a student, but he still hasn’t found his place in life. He’s spiraling downward: using illegal substances, working a job he hates, slowly fading away. He begins to see a girl everywhere - a girl who once loved him. He sees her in dreams, in passing strangers... Each encounter reminds him of his vices, the mistakes he’s made. 

Will he be able to learn the lessons from these dances of a troubled subconscious - lessons that could help change his life for the better - or will he become forever lost in the world he’s created in his own mind...?

Gameplay Features:

  • An atmospheric drama with psychological thriller elements
    Dive into the world of the main character, where the boundaries between dreams and reality blur. Help Nikita make choices that determine his future.

  • Non-linear story and decision-based outcomes
    Every action and choice leads to new scenarios and endings.

  • A visual novel with point-and-click elements
    Pay attention! Every detail might matter, and only by exploring the protagonist’s inner world can you find a way out of the loop.

  • Surreal first-person quest sequences

    Explore paranormal spaces, solve symbolic puzzles, and experience tense 3D segments that reveal the depths of        Nikita’s psyche.

  • Dark visual style
    Post-Soviet landscapes: courtyards, train stations, panel housing. The aesthetics are an important part of the story.
